meta_title: Nephrite: The emerald standard for your browser
meta_description: A calm, low-glare jade theme for Chrome, with a variant for any light. Firefox and VS Code are next.
hero_body: A calm, low-glare theme for Chrome. Every surface tuned, with a shade of jade for any light.
variants_title: Pick the green that fits your light.
variants_body: Forest for late nights. Mint and Jade for daylight. Switch any time from Chrome settings.
details_title: Small decisions, all the way down.
detail_eyes_body: Muted greens and tuned contrast keep long sessions comfortable, from the first tab to the fortieth.
detail_surfaces_body: Nephrite colors the parts of Chrome you look at all day.
detail_open_body: Every color lives in a public repository. Fork it, tweak it, send a pull request.
rm_chrome_body: The flagship theme, in every variant.
rm_firefox_body: The same jade palette, adapted to Firefox's toolbar and sidebar.
rm_vscode_body: Syntax colors and editor chrome built from the same stone.
rm_spotify_body: A quieter player to match the rest of your desk.
rm_terminal_body: Profiles for Windows Terminal, iTerm2 and Hyper.
closing_body: Firefox and VS Code are next. Follow the progress on GitHub or X.
footer_tagline: The emerald standard for your browser.
